mapper.select: WITH PARENTPAGE AS ( SELECT P.REPL_NUMB FROM TB_REPLXX P WHERE P.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} AND P.UPER_NUMB IS NULL ORDER BY P.REGI_DATE DESC , P.REPL_NUMB DESC LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{pageLimit} ) SELECT /* getReplyList */ R.REPT_NUMB , R.REPL_NUMB , R.UPER_NUMB , IF(R.UPER_NUMB IS NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS PARENT_YN , R.USER_NUMB , CASE WHEN R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS MY_REPLY_YN , R.REPL_CNTN , R.DELT_YSNO , R.REGI_DATE , R.UPDT_DATE , SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|' , COALESCE(R.REPL_CNTN, '') , COALESCE(R.DELT_YSNO, '') ), 256) AS EDIT_VERSION , IF(R.UPDT_DATE IS NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS UPDT_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UPDT_YSNO', IF(R.UPDT_DATE IS NULL, 'N', 'Y'), NULL) AS UPDT_YSNO_NM , U.USER_NICK , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , CASE WHEN R.DELT_YSNO = #{commYes} THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0) END AS LIKE_CNT , CASE WHEN R.DELT_YSNO = #{commYes} THEN #{commNo} WHEN UL.USER_NUMB IS NULL THEN #{commNo} ELSE #{commYes} END AS LIKE_YSNO FROM TB_REPLXX R INNER JOIN PARENTPAGE PAGE ON PAGE.REPL_NUMB = COALESCE(R.UPER_NUMB, R.REPL_NUMB) LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON R.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_REPLXX P ON P.REPT_NUMB = R.REPT_NUMB AND P.REPL_NUMB = R.UPER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX L JOIN TB_REPLXX LR ON LR.REPL_NUMB = L.TAGT_NUMB AND LR.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} JOIN TM_USERXM LU ON LU.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND LU.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReply} GROUP BY L.TAGT_NUMB ) LC ON LC.TAGT_NUMB = R.REPL_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_LIKEXX UL ON UL.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND UL.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReply} AND UL.TAGT_NUMB = R.REPL_NUMB WHERE R.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} ORDER BY COALESCE(P.REGI_DATE, R.REGI_DATE) DESC , COALESCE(P.REPL_NUMB, R.REPL_NUMB) DESC , CASE WHEN R.UPER_NUMB IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC , R.REGI_DATE DESC , R.REPL_NUMB DESC
SELECT /* getReplyReportAlimDtl */ USER_NUMB AS TARGET_USER_NUMB , RPAL_YSNO AS REPLY_ALIM_YSNO FROM TM_REPORT WHERE REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb}
